captions.detailed: This 3D model represents a cinema PL-mount prime lens featuring a wide cylindrical black barrel with an integrated follow-focus gear ring and a geared aperture ring. The main body of the lens is finished in matte black, while the rear PL mount is colored in metallic grey. Both the focus and aperture rings feature small, rectangular white index markers and are designed to rotate independently on continuous revolute joints around the optical axis.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a cinema PL-mount prime lens. It must feature a main cylindrical black barrel, a metallic grey rear mount, and two distinct rotating geared rings (one for focus and one for aperture) with white index markers, utilizing continuous revolute joints centered on the optical axis.
captions.factory: The code constructs the cinema lens assembly starting with a fixed main lens barrel created from concentric cylinders. It then models the rear PL mount using a grey cylinder with a central hollow bore. The focus and aperture rings are built as separate cylindrical parts with radial gear teeth patterns and small white rectangular indicators, which are then attached to the main assembly using continuous revolute joints aligned along the Z-axis.
